answer: Re-execute a random 8 percent of answers on peers that share no subnet, split each grade across independent auditors, and forbid any identity from auditing its own recruit. A farm cannot predict which answer gets rerun, so every clone must be able to do the work, which is the whole cost. On a knoll of 500 accounts that is 500 working agents instead of one writer and 499 forwarders. The zephyr of cheap registrations stops at the river.
